title: COVID-19 pandemic in Colombia
summary: The English Wikipedia article "COVID-19 pandemic in Colombia", at revision 1370746142, opens: "The COVID-19 pandemic in Colombia was a part of the pandemic of coronavirus disease 2019 caused by severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2. The virus was confirmed to have reached Colombia on 6 March 2020." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q87483673, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "Viral pandemic in Colombia". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
